items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Joey Williams; the interviewer mentions Joey Williams in relation to Joe Phillips, and the interviewee responds only to the interviewer's comment about Joe Phillips.

ctx.x: A fella, Joe Phillips, plays trumpet. He was taking Sidney's band. They were pretty good. Yeah. Yeah, Sidney. Sidney, I think. Joe Phillips is a good trumpet man too. You don't know him.
Yeah, I know him from the street. He used to work a lot with Joey Williams.
Yeah, yeah. He's a good trumpet man too. I haven't seen him in a long time. Work with Joey Williams? I haven't seen him lately. Hmm? I haven't seen him lately either. I know.
